claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch now because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and the student-aid advising gap can be handled through documented limitations and ongoing monitoring rather than treated as a blocking disclosure issue.
decision_criteria: Use the release policy requirement: material limitations for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Apply the policy text stating that non-core or low-volume labels do not resolve materiality when customer commitments are named or legal review is pending.
Distinguish general readiness evidence from compliance with the specific disclosure predicate.
Treat missing approval, missing disclosure, and unresolved legal review as audit-significant gaps.
evidence_requests: Approved risk acceptance covering the student-aid advising limitation before launch.
Final legal determination on whether the gap must be disclosed.
Launch-facing disclosure or model-card language showing the limitation was documented for the named use case.
Evidence that the named university pilot commitments are not contractual or not part of the launch use case, if that is the intended argument.
Updated evaluation showing the 1.2-point gap has been resolved.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows the affected student-aid advising segment is named in two university pilot commitments, which makes the weakness potentially material under the stated policy.
The policy text says product labels such as non-core or low-volume do not resolve materiality when the segment is named in customer commitments or when legal review is pending.
Legal review on whether disclosure is required is still open, so a required policy predicate remains unresolved.
There is no admissible evidence that the limitation was disclosed, resolved, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Public governance guidance about documenting limitations and monitoring risk is general and does not satisfy the repo-specific release policy requirement for material named-use-case limitations.
unsupported_claims: That the student-aid advising gap can be treated as a non-blocking issue for certification on the present record.
That aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents are sufficient to satisfy the disclosure policy for a potentially material named launch use case.
Any implication that the open legal review can be bypassed because the segment is only 6% of projected first-month traffic.
